coordination_negative_result: Parallel GO workers can collide on unusual-experiment accounting and shared frontiers. CAS/lease discipline remains required. This run additionally confirmed that equivalent valid implementations should not become parallel canonical paths: PR #663 was closed without merge after #660 landed and passed exact-head CI; only the distinct cyclic-order research evidence was retained. Pull-request workflows must checkout and assert github.event.pull_request.head.sha rather than treating github.sha merge refs as exact candidate evidence.
